parameter.name: SupportedWiFiGenerations
parameter.description:
A bit map indicating each Wi-Fi generation supported by this {{object}}
* Bit 0: Wi-Fi HaLow (802.11ah) * Bit 1: Wi-Fi 1 (802.11b) * Bit 2: Wi-Fi 2 (802.11a) * Bit 3: Wi-Fi 3 (802.11g) * Bit 4: Wi-Fi 4 (802.11n) * Bit 5: Wi-Fi 5 (802.11ac) * Bit 6: Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) * Bit 7: Wi-Fi 7 (802.11be) * Bit 8: Wi-Fi 8 (802.11bn)
Notes: * This list will be expanded in the future as new Wi-Fi generation appears. * Indications are for the device, not the 802.11 STA per se. For example, an 802.11ac device sets the Wi-Fi 5 Supported bit even if it's currently connected on the 2.4GHz band. * Bits are counted from the LSB (bit 0) to the MSB.
If the STA includes a Generational Capabilities Indication attribute, as defined in {{bibref|WFA Capabilities|Table 6}} in its (Re)Association Request frames or in its Wi-Fi Alliance Capabilities frames, the information about support for Wi-Fi 4 and above may be retrieved from this attribute. In addition, or alternatively when the STA doesn't include a Generational Capabilities Indication attribute in its (Re)Association Request frames and Wi-Fi Alliance Capabilities frames, the DataElements Agent may use the following guidance to infer STA support of a Wi-Fi generation: * If a STA includes a S1G Capabilities IE in its (Re)Association Request frames, the DataElements Agent indicates support for Wi-Fi HaLow for this STA. * If a STA includes a Supported Rates IE in its (Re)Association Request frames and if either 1, 2, 5.5 or 11 Mbps rate is indicated in this IE, the DataElements Agent indicates support for Wi-Fi 1 (802.11b) for this STA. * If a STA includes a Supported Rates IE in its (Re)Association Request frames and if either 6, 12 or 24 Mbps rate is indicated in this IE when sent on the 5GHz band, the DataElements Agent indicates support for Wi-Fi 2 (802.11a) for this STA. * If a STA includes a Supported Rates IE in its (Re)Association Request frames and if either 6, 12 or 24 Mbps rate is indicated in this IE when sent on the 2.4GHz band, the DataElements Agent indicates support for Wi-Fi 3 (802.11g) for this STA. * If a STA includes a HT Capabilities IE in its (Re)Association Request frames, the DataElements Agent indicates support for Wi-Fi 4 for this STA. * If a STA includes a VHT Capabilities IE in its (Re)Association Request frames, the DataElements Agent indicates support for Wi-Fi 5 for this STA. * If a STA includes a HE Capabilities IE in its (Re)Association Request frames, the DataElements Agent indicates support for Wi-Fi 6 for this STA. * If a STA includes a EHT Capabilities IE in its (Re)Association Request frames, the DataElements Agent indicates support for Wi-Fi 7 for this STA. * If a STA includes a UHR Capabilities IE in its (Re)Association Request frames, the DataElements Agent indicates support for Wi-Fi 8 for this STA.
Notes: * In case of a Multi-AP deployment, the DataElements Agent / Multi-AP Controller obtains the body of the (Re)Association Request frames sent by the STA by using either the Tunneled Message mechanism defined in {{bibref|EasyMesh|Section 11.7}} or the Client Capability procedure defined in {{bibref|EasyMesh|Section 9.2}}. * In case of a Multi-AP deployment, the DataElements Agent / Multi-AP Controller obtains the body of the Wi-Fi Alliance Capabilities frames sent by the STA by using the Tunneled Message mechanism defined in {{bibref|EasyMesh|Section 11.7}}.

parameter.name: WFACapabilities
parameter.description:
A bit map indicating each WFA Capability supported by this {{object}}, as defined in {{bibref|WFA Capabilities|Table 3}}
* Bit 0: QoS Management DSCP Policy * Bit 1: QoS Management Unsolicited DSCP Policy At Association * Bit 2: QoS Management SCS Traffic Description * Bit 3: 5G QoS to Wi-Fi QoS Mapping * Bit 4: DAR Latency Statistics Reporting Support * Bit 5: DAR Radio Counters Statistics Reporting Support * Bit 6: DAR Control Plane Events Reporting Support * Bit 7: DAR Unsolicited Report Reception Support
A value of 0 indicates that either the information has not been provided by the STA or that the STA doesn't support any of the capabilities listed in {{bibref|WFA Capabilities|Table 3}}.
Notes: * This information is copied from the Capabilities field included in the Wi-Fi Alliance Capabilities Element or Wi-Fi Alliance Capabilities frame, as defined in {{bibref|WFA Capabilities|Table 3}}. * Bits are counted from the LSB (bit 0) to the MSB.
